ground_truth: In `ShadowCss._scopeSelector`/`_applySelectorScope`, the change replaced the simple `/ ?, ?/` comma split and the combinator separator with regexes that do not split inside parentheses. A selector part like `.foo:is(.a,\n.b)` therefore now reaches `_scopeSelectorPart` as a single string that can contain newlines. That function splits the part with `/([^:]*)(:*)(.*)/`, both in the newly added pseudo-function `:host` branch (`scopedP.match(...)`) and in the non-host branch (`t.match(...)`). Because `.` does not match a newline, everything after the first newline is silently dropped. For example, a component style `.foo:is(.a,\n.b) {}` is emitted as `.foo[contenta]:is(.a,`, with the rest of the selector and the closing parenthesis lost, which breaks the stylesheet. The fix changed the trailing group of both regexes to `([\s\S]*)` so content after newlines is kept.
